name: Miso

grow.label: NEW KITTEN
grow.text: Grown up in 29 days. Kittens play more, nap more and have higher little voices.

hint: Strays take a few days to trust you. Regular meals are how a cat learns you are safe.

care.how: How it works. Feed about twice a day, at least four hours apart. A hungry cat tells you with its behavior, never with a notification. A cat that goes a very long time with no food will get weak, and about a week without food can be fatal.
care.bond: Bond. It grows from regular meals, gentle petting (3 a day count) and play (2 a day count). Strays are shy at first. Close friends greet you, follow your finger, rub against you and sometimes bring gifts.
care.vacationHint: Pauses hunger while you are away. Turn it off when you are back.
care.name: Miso

words.blinkHint: A slow blink is how cats say they feel safe
words.moreText: The toy tray, the cattery and adopting another cat open on the page.
The toy tray, the cattery and adopting another cat open on the page.

mind.text: Miso is calm. Still working out whether you are safe. Let him come to you.

likes.body: Cats pick their own spots. Time spent somewhere, and good moments there, slowly make a favorite. Toys you choose for him count a little more.
likes.noPlaces: No favorite places yet. Give it a day or two.

inner.body: How he feels about you is more than one number. Respecting his signals (ears back, a twitching tail) builds trust. Letting him come to you builds confidence.

quirks.name: Shadow chaser
quirks.text: He pounces on his own shadow.

quirks.name: Dramatic flopper
quirks.text: He flops over sideways instead of sitting when he is very happy.

morph.title: Body shape
morph.intro: Proportions come from several genes each, so they vary smoothly and are passed on strongly. Breed two long-eared cats and their kittens tend to have long ears too. (Shown for the grown cat.)

rows.label: Ear length · rather tiny
rows.note: 0.75× the standard art · 3 of 10 lengthening alleles

rows.label: Ear width · average
rows.note: 1.11× the standard art · 3 of 6 lengthening alleles

rows.label: Tail length · average
rows.note: 1.09× the standard art · 5 of 10 lengthening alleles

rows.label: Leg length · average
rows.note: 0.99× the standard art · 5 of 10 lengthening alleles

rows.label: Body length · average
rows.note: 1.05× the standard art · 4 of 8 lengthening alleles

rows.label: Whisker length · rather short
rows.note: 0.75× the standard art · 1 of 4 lengthening alleles

dna.title: Genetics
dna.coat: Ginger mackerel tabby with a white locket
dna.sub: Green eyes · about 5 kg as an adult (still growing).

rows.label: Sex
rows.text: The Y chromosome (SRY) makes a male.

rows.label: Orange · ARHGAP36 · X
rows.text: Orange on his only X. Males need just one copy, so most ginger cats are male.

rows.label: Agouti · ASIP · A3
rows.text: Banded hairs: the tabby pattern shows.

rows.label: White · KIT · B1
rows.text: A small white locket. The spotting grade comes from several modifier genes.

carries.rest: (hidden, can be passed on): solid colour, classic tabby, long hair.

hidden.rest: Red hides the black/brown gene and whether the cat is agouti: red cats always show tabby markings.

temperament.title: Temperament
temperament.intro: About half of each comes from his genes, the rest from how he developed before you met. He reads as

persona.label: Skittish
persona.word: Startles easily, likes high and hidden places

persona.label: Dominant
persona.word: Bossy with other cats, scratches to mark

persona.label: Friendly
persona.word: Rubs, slow blinks, comes to the glass
